test_scan_with_unstacked: test the scan_with_unstacked function with unstack=True to transpose stacked outputs into tuples
test_scan_with_unstacked_no_length: test the scan_with_unstacked function without explicit length to infer it from input sequence
test_scan_with_unstacked_jitted: test the scan_with_unstacked function wrapped in jax.jit with static_argnames for f, length, and unstack
test_scan_with_unstacked_mixed: test the scan_with_unstacked function with mixed unstack settings to selectively unstack some outputs
test_scan_with_unstacked_none: test the scan_with_unstacked function with unstack=False to keep outputs stacked as arrays
